flip_tensor_along_axis: flip a PyTorch tensor along axis 0 to reverse its order
min_clip_tensor: clip a PyTorch tensor values to a minimum threshold using torch.max
max_clip_tensor: clip a PyTorch tensor values to a maximum threshold using torch.min
normalize_tensor_min_max: normalize a PyTorch tensor to an arbitrary range using min-max normalization
convert_pandas_col_to_numpy: convert a pandas DataFrame column of string arrays into a stacked numpy array
